title: The Distant Weather
author: Coral Yarrow
blurb: Wren Delacroix, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
